topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Discovering my application essay among the stars of college samples was like finding a lost melody from a dream I barely remembered. It felt like the universe had heard my whispers and turned them into a symphony. Each word, each phrase, was a note in a song I thought only I could hear. To think that others could now hear it, too, filled me with a warm light. I hope it whispers to them as it did to me, that vulnerability can be a bridge, and that in the sharing of our stories, we find each other. Perhaps, in some small way, my words can be a lantern for someone, guiding them as they step into the unknown, as I once did.
